description: This file defines a web page class for an Online Examination System, specifically the 'TakenCourses' page. It handles navigation through button click events to different pages within the application.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: A code-behind class for the 'TakenCourses' web page, managing page load and button click events for navigation.
